title: Instruction generator
desc: The AI reads your trader's data, asks you one question at a time and writes a version of your trading instructions once it knows enough. Say what to change and it keeps asking until it thinks the instructions are done.
restartHint: Starting clears the current conversation; the latest 3 versions are kept.
startHint: The endpoint is only used for these few rounds; your key never leaves your account.
noEndpoint: No model endpoint yet — set one up on the AI page.
doneHint: Done — copy the body into My Trader; say what to change if you want more
wrotePruned: Wrote v{{no}} (only the latest 3 are kept; this one is gone)
rollbackConfirm: Replace the current conversation with the one from v{{no}} and continue from there?
copyFailed: Copy failed, select the text and copy it yourself
empty: The first version shows up here once the required questions are answered.
